findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?api_key={api_key}" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_amazon, get_amazon_product, get_amazon_reviews, list_bestsellers, list_new_releases, list_seller_products, list_category_products, search_categories, get_category_children, filter_categories, filter_niches, ai_search, keyword_trends, scrape_url, search_amazon_alexa · Private data: filter_niches · Public sink: search_amazon_alexa · Destructive: search_amazon, get_amazon_reviews, list_seller_products, ai_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_amazon, get_amazon_product, get_amazon_reviews, list_bestsellers, list_new_releases, list_seller_products, list_category_products, search_categories, get_category_children, filter_categories, filter_niches, ai_search, keyword_trends, scrape_url, search_amazon_alexa · Private data: filter_niches · Public sink: search_amazon_alexa · Destructive: search_amazon, get_amazon_reviews, list_seller_products, ai_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
